notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixed:

[list]
[*] Clicking through setting's window in mini-games
[*] Hint issue with the wrench
[*] Issue with Number "3" in Second Chapter
[*] Issue with stickers on the board in Fifth Chapter
[*] Issue with transitions in some levels
[*] Issue with raspberry and a small door
[*] Issue clicking through setting's window in main scenes
[*] Speed of Bug in Bug mini-game has been changed
[*] Layers in Bug Game
[*] Issue with save files
[/list]

ATTENTION
If you have some huge issue like inability to move from one scene to another you should start a new profile after you update the game.

notes.title: Huge update
notes.content:
Hey guys! :absolem:

We are keep working on Varenje to make it better! Reading your emails and messages and listening to your suggestions. :light_my_fire:

So here are few things we added in this update:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with saves
[*] Fixed issue with in-game menu
[*] Fixed issue with freezing
[*] Radio mini-game remastered
[*] Cutscenes subtitles timing changed
[*] Added new animations and visual effects
[*] Last achievement meta game changed(a little :))
[/list]

If you have any issues or suggestions don't hesistate to contact us! ːsteamhappyː

notes.content:
